name: Aesop's Fables

moral.label: Moral
moral.hint: Which lesson the fable mainly teaches.
moral.question: What is the main lesson of {item}?

options.greed: Greed or wanting more than you need leads to loss.
options.vanity: Pride, boasting, or vanity brings a fall.
options.flattery: Beware of flatterers; flattery is used to get something from you.
options.kindness: Kindness or mercy is repaid, even by the small.
options.foresight: Plan ahead and prepare; foresight and hard work pay off.
options.tyranny: The powerful oppress the weak and will always find an excuse.
options.envy: Envy or jealousy harms the one who feels it.
options.unity: Unity, loyalty, or friendship gives strength.
options.none: None of these lessons; something else.

harsh.label: Harshness
harsh.hint: How badly things end for the main character.
harsh.question: How harshly does {item} end for its main character?
levels: They learn a lesson without real harm.
They suffer a painful loss or humiliation.

bedtime.label: Bedtime-safe
bedtime.hint: Whether it suits a five-year-old at bedtime.
bedtime.question: Is {item} a gentle story suitable to read to a five-year-old at bedtime?
bedtime.true: No death, cruelty, or frightening violence; a gentle lesson.
bedtime.false: Contains death, being eaten, cruelty, or frightening violence.

presets.title: Moral
